finding.title: Integer Overflow or Wraparound
finding.trigger: User inputs a value that exceeds the range of an int
finding.assumptions: The program assumes that the user input will fit within the bounds of an int. The input is not validated to ensure it falls within a safe range.

finding.title: OS Command Injection
finding.trigger: User inputs a value that leads to an OS command execution
finding.assumptions: The program does not execute any OS commands directly. However, if the input is used later in a way that constructs a command, this could lead to OS command injection.

finding.title: Buffer Overflow
finding.trigger: User inputs a value that causes a buffer overflow
finding.assumptions: The program assumes that the input will fit within the bounds of the buffer. The input is not validated to ensure it falls within a safe range.

finding.title: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an OS Command ('OS Command Injection')

finding.assumptions: The program does not execute any OS commands directly. However, if the input is used later in a way that constructs a command, this could lead to OS command injection.
